confidence_rationale: The source-monitoring framework is the foundational and still-dominant account of how the cognitive system attributes a remembered event to its origin (perceived vs imagined, internal vs external, this-source vs that-source). It directly grounds MECH-365's central design move -- that provenance is a represented attribute of an event rather than a free-floating mode bit -- and the reality-monitoring sub-case is the biological form of the committed_vs_imagined field. Held below 0.8 because the framework treats provenance as a RECONSTRUCTIVE, probabilistic attribution made at retrieval (and routinely WRONG), which is in tension with MECH-365's stronger one-way, never-violated gate; the framework supports the existence and dimensionality of the field but partly weakens the absoluteness of the gate.
failure_signatures: Source monitoring is a heuristic, reconstructive judgement made at retrieval from imperfect cues (vividness, sensory detail, cognitive-operation traces), not a stored ground-truth label -- so the human system routinely MISattributes imagined events as perceived (the source-misattribution errors that ARE confabulation/false memory). This weakens MECH-365's premise that committed_vs_imagined can be a reliably-enforced, one-way, first-class field rather than a fallible after-the-fact inference.

Because 'source' is multidimensional with indefinitely many values, a single binary committed_vs_imagined bit may be an under-specification: provenance failures occur along many axes (who said it, when, internally-generated-by-me vs by-another), not just real-vs-imagined.

mapping.source_claim_statement: Memories do not carry intrinsic source labels; the source of a memory (perceived vs imagined, internally vs externally generated, one external source vs another) is ATTRIBUTED by decision processes operating on qualitative characteristics of the memory record (perceptual/contextual/semantic detail, records of cognitive operations). Reality monitoring -- distinguishing internally generated from externally derived memories -- is one sub-case; 'source' is a multidimensional construct, and source attributions can be and frequently are wrong.
mapping.ree_translation: MECH-365's provenance-bearing event token: every event token carries explicit provenance fields {source_status, committed_vs_imagined} and the committed_vs_imagined label is first-class and load-bearing. The source-monitoring framework is the biology that makes 'provenance is a represented attribute of an event' a grounded design move rather than an engineering convenience, and reality monitoring is the direct analogue of the committed_vs_imagined distinction. Also grounds ARC-085's claim that event tokens are bound to perspective, self-state and source rather than being neutral storage.
mapping.mapping_caveat: The framework's provenance is RECONSTRUCTED at retrieval and is fallible -- the source-misattribution errors it catalogues ARE confabulation. MECH-365 instead posits a one-way gate that imagined tokens can NEVER cross into committed status. So the human substrate evidences that provenance is a represented, multidimensional attribute (supports MECH-365's data structure) but simultaneously shows the biological version is leaky (does NOT support, and partly undercuts, the absoluteness of MECH-365's gate). Human cognitive psychology; healthy + clinical populations.
mapping.source_context: Human cognitive psychology; integrative theoretical review spanning recognition, eyewitness memory, cryptomnesia, confabulation, amnesia and aging.

confidence_components.notes: Foundational, field-defining review (Psychological Bulletin, thousands of citations). Mapping fidelity discounted because the framework grounds the FIELD (provenance as a represented, multidimensional attribute) more strongly than it grounds the GATE (one-way, never-violated) -- on the gate it is arguably a weakening signal, captured in failure_signatures. Net direction is 'supports' for the data-structure claim that is MECH-365's actual content.
